# Golden Section

The _Golden Section_ (or _Golden Mean_) is an irrational proportion defined as a line cut in such a way that:

- The _ratio between the smaller section to the greater_ equals the _ratio of the greater section to the whole line_

**Formula:** AB / BC = BC / AC

**Golden Ratio (Φ) ≈ 1.618033988749895**
